description: Works out compensation for a delayed or cancelled flight under UK261 or EU261. Takes the flight number and date. What happened comes from flight-status records, which cover about the last year, or from what_happened and arrival_delay_minutes when given. Returns the matched route, the arrival delay, the distance band, the amount per passenger, the extraordinary-circumstances caveat, the airline’s claim page, the dispute body for a refused claim, deadline guidance, a claim pack and the details needed to save the claim to an Untap account. When the airports given differ from the flight-status record, the result says so. No sign-in needed. Journey details are not saved to an account; limited usage metadata is recorded.

arrival_delay_minutes.description: How late the flight arrived at the gate, in minutes, if the person knows. Compensation turns on arrival, not departure.

cancellation_notice_days.description: For a cancellation: how many days before departure the airline told the person. 14 or more means no compensation.

date.description: Date the flight was due to depart, local time. YYYY-MM-DD is best.

flight_number.description: Airline code and number, as on the booking: "BA2551", "U2 8123".

from_airport.description: Three-letter departure airport code, if known: "LGW". Helps pick the right flight on multi-stop numbers.

price_paid.description: Optional. Not used for the amount, which is fixed in law, but needed to save the claim to an account.

to_airport.description: Three-letter arrival airport code, if known: "BCN".

what_happened.description: What happened, if known. When left out, Untap looks it up in flight-status records.

name: check_flight_compensation
title: Check a flight for UK261 or EU261 compensation
